newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable in quiet trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Wednesday after opening lower, with buying interest staying weak, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,460-65 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but offers were also heard at 1,450-55 rupiah for volumes exceeding 100 tonnes.
The traders said crude palm oil continued to be offered at 1,300 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran city of Medan, but buyers were looking to buy at 1,280 rupiah.
"Anything higher than 1,280 rupiah will be too high at the current price of olein," one trader said.
